Dialogs.Dialog: Just for future reference, can I ask you something？
For breakfast, do you prefer bread or rice？
Is that so？ That really makes it worth cooking.
Wait, are you gonna make me breakfast？
Then maybe I'll treat you to freshly baked bread in the morning？
Rice in the morning, I think.
Huh, did you get tired of bread？
Right now, yeah. I'm feeling bread.
I see... Well, if I don't have to cook rice, I can spend more time on the rest.
Could you tell me what you like to eat？ Japanese, Western, Chinese...？
Japanese, huh？ Yeah, it's healthy and delicious.
Is that so？ Out of all things, Japanese food？
It's nothing. Mmh, I'll have to train hard...
Most of my favorites are Western food, I think.
I prefer Western food, if I had to choose.
Really？ Western food's not my strong suit...
Uh... then Japanese or Chinese is fine, too!
Sorry, don't worry about it. It's fine, I'll practice.
Hmm, I think I like Chinese food best.
Alright, Chinese, then. Leave that to me!
No, I like it. ...Eating it, at least.
What I really like is something a bit different...
Do you like unusual food？ Yeah, thinking up recipes could be fun!
What ● likes wasn't on that list... It's a bit different.
If that's the case... it might be a bit hard to picture.
Well, I haven't really thought that deeply about it.
Still, if I don't think of one, she can't make it...
Tell me just one food you've been liking lately. What is it？
I see. Then I'd better add that to my repertoire, too.
Sweet! I'm really looking forward to it.
You really like it that much？ Are you picky about it？
It's not that, it's just that my tastes haven't changed.
Didn't you answer differently before？ Did you end up liking that one too？
Yeah, I guess I prefer this one right now.
Hey, random question... Do you have a preference for how long a girl's socks are？
As long as it looks good
Why not try shorter ones？ It gives off an energetic vibe, don't you think？
Hmm, you like that kind？ I see.
Well, normal length seems best, don't you think？
True. That way it won't look weird, at least.
Maybe long ones. Just kind of a hunch.
Right. There are lots of fancy designs, so that could be fun.
Whatever matches your outfit and looks good on you seems best, don't you think？
I have a favor to ask. If you have something to tell me, please just say it honestly.
I said a lot of things when we fought, didn't I？ So...
I told you, I don't mind
Hey, you can be honest with me, you know？
I know I said some harsh things when we fought, so...
I think it was for the best
I've been... really feeling bad about it.
Because I made you feel awful during our fight the other day.
I didn't mind it at all
Fights aren't all bad, you know.
Huh!? What do you mean, not bad...？
As long as we make up afterwards, that's what counts. Being close enough to fight is a good thing, really.
I see... You really felt that way about it？ Yeah...
I think it was for the best, though？
Yeah. We both spoke our minds, and it feels like it brought us closer together, don't you think？
I guess... maybe you're right. Though I wouldn't want it happening too often, okay？
I didn't mind it at all, really. So you don't need to feel bad.
But... I can't just let it go like that.
We both learned that we hate fighting with each other, so that's enough, isn't it？
...Look at you, acting all cool. My boyfriend really is so sweet.
I'm not bothered, so it's fine.
That's all. I'm not mad at ● at all.
...You really are so sweet. Let's keep being good together, okay？
Not minding at all... That can't be true, can it？
I mean it. So don't worry about it anymore either, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
...Okay. If you say so, I'll take your word for it. Thank you.
It's fine now. I think we've both learned our lesson anyway.
Yeah. I really don't mind, ●. So let's keep taking good care of each other, okay？
...Gladly! Let's keep taking good care of each other, okay？
Truth is, it was a little rough on me.
...Yeah, of course it did. Thank you for telling me.
Still, there's no point in hurting each other, so...
I see... Thank you. I'll be gentler with you, I promise...
Well, it did hurt a bit, sure, but...
But bringing it up again won't help. Things like this happen when you're dating.
Look at you being positive. Mm, good boy. Then I won't ask about it anymore.
I definitely felt awful back then, sure, but...
It's fine now. You felt bad too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, so that makes us pretty much even, right？
...All right. I won't say another word about this. Time to cheer up！
There's something I've been meaning to ask you.
I mean... As a boyfriend, you'd want your girlfriend's cooking to be good, right？
Well, I'd definitely be happier if it's good. I love eating tasty food.
Right？ In that case, I'll try even harder from now on.
Though I'm confident I'd enjoy anything you cook, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Don't worry, I'll make you food you can honestly say is delicious.
●, just getting to eat my girlfriend's cooking is plenty. I'd feel bad asking for anything more！
...Thank you. Hearing you say that makes me really happy.
Even if it's bad, wouldn't that be fine？
What makes ● happy isn't whether the cooking is good or bad, but that ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is making it for me.
...Hearing you say that makes me feel all ticklish.
